implementation: Core decides and freezes the strict nativeConstruction marker at the first matching ADDON_LOADED event, preserving malformed records for restore-only handling.
Agent defers surface creation until an ordinary ADDON_LOADED branch or an admitted deferred Construct callback; construction failures hide partial frames and persist failed/restore-only state.
Scanner projects independent native and logout fences and blocks unknown/malformed construction state at every scan entry.
Commands owns the fixed 220x84 TOPRIGHT panel and exact defer/release/recover/finalize grammar; Construct and Restore remain button-owned callbacks.
The harness models SavedVariables injection, named controls, ReloadUI, and callback/error paths; the fixture retains a legacy format-2 scan beside an unknown marker.
limitations: Offline-only implementation; no game input, GUI, daemon/controller/native helper, service restart, deployment, or live qualification was performed.
The addon cannot prove the daemon-supplied release/recovery ticket; those boundaries remain for the separate native/helper slices.
